name: space-age-all-in-one
title: Space Age All in One - Simulacruis
author: lad338
description: Adds Simulacruis, a starting planet combining Nauvis, Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba and Aquilo's biomes, resources and enemies into zones, with de-gated research and crafting restrictions so you can experience all of Space Age from one planet.
